sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- A.S.G.I.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Donadi Ramesh,J.
1.

Heard Sri Anurag Shukla, learned counsel for the petitioner, Sri Brijesh Kumar, learned Central Government Counsel for respondent no. 1, learned Standing counsel for the State-respondents and Sri Rishabh Pratap Singh Kachhwah, holding brief of Sri Rahul Agarwal, learned counsel appearing for respondent no.4.
2.

The instant petition has been filed praying for quashing of the order dated 9.5.2018, whereby the name of Reliance Gas Pipeline Ltd. has been mutated in the khatauni in respect of khasra no. 443 Harish Chandra Shukla vs Union Of India And 3 Others on 11 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153908490/
1 after expunging the name of the petitioner.

entities.text: Harish Chandra Shukla vs Union Of India And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioner has also prayed for a direction to the respondents to decide his representation dated 03.02.2023, wherein the petitioner has stated that since name of Reliance Gas Pipeline Ltd. has been mutated in the revenue records, therefore, the petitioner should be paid compensation in accordance with the provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter referred to as the Act, 2013).

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. By order dated 4.10.2023, we directed the respondents to clarify their stand.
In pursuance thereof, Competent Authority/Special Land Acquisition Officer (Joint Organization), Prayagraj has submitted written instructions dated 10.10.2023, which is taken on record.
According to it, the respondents have not acquired the land of the petitioner.

Only right of user was acquired in accordance with the provisions of the Petroleum and Minerals Pipelines (Acquisition of Right of User in Land) Act, 1962 (hereinafter referred to as the Act, 1962) for purposes of laying a pipeline by Messers Reliance Gas Pipeline Ltd.

entities.text: Petroleum and Minerals Pipelines (Acquisition of Right of User in Land) Act, 1962
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It was only by mistake that the name of the Reliance Gas Pipeline Ltd. was mutated in the khatauni.

However, on 9.10.2023, an order has been passed by Competent Authority/Special Land Acquisition Officer (Joint Organization), Prayagraj directing Tehsildar, Meja, Prayagraj to correct the mistake and restore the name of the petitioner.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner tried to contend that the respondents should pay compensation to the petitioner as per provisions of the Act, 2013.
5. It is not disputed before us that there is no notification for acquisition of any part of the land of the petitioner under the provisions of the Act, 2013.
The respondents have only acquired right of use in land by issuing notification under Section 6 of the Act, 1962.
Thereunder an award was also made.
The petitioner being aggrieved thereby is stated to have filed a reference, which is pending before the reference court.
The petitioner has also filed some writ petition before this Court with certain grievance in relation to the manner in which the proceedings are being conducted by the reference court.
In the said writ petition, a counter has been invited from the respondents and the writ petition is still pending.

6. Having regard to the stand of the respondents that they have already directed for restoration of the name of the petitioner, we are of the opinion that the grievance of the petitioner stands redressed.
As regards to payment of compensation under the Act, 2013, no question arises as there is no acquisition of any land of the petitioner under the provisions of the said Act.
7. Petition stands disposed of accordingly.
(Donadi Ramesh, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 11.10.2023
